title: Prove one-query endpoint and paid-scan bounds for the triangular carrier
body:
## Summary

- For the fixed triangular carrier C_f=[[Q_f−I,N_f],[Q_f,0]], exclude an all-size one-query factorization over a fixed finite uniform-tensor physical-monomial endpoint dictionary.
- Allow growing nonuniform endpoint controllers and prove K_G·K_F≥4^f, hence at least 2f scalar bank ADDs. Growing paid O(f) ADD words remain permitted.
- Add only `research/one-query-endpoint-scan/`, including the actual 19 native 64×64 Gaussian base matrices and a restored-helper argument with its queried-width boundary.

## Scope and limits

The helper extension retains its carrier-row vanishing premise and queried width ≤M. Changed cuts, multi-bank queries, wider queried helpers, nonmonomial endpoints and cross-cut sharing remain outside the theorem. Written all-parameter proofs are distinguished from finite base checks.

The repeated, varied-primal and primal/dual-route five-query searches are an archival appendix. The registered command hashes their receipts but does not rerun those searches; they do not establish a general five-query impossibility. No complete-caller stock floor, new κ, selected-frontier change, physical supplier admission or formal-kernel theorem is claimed.

See the [proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf793d8739ad26f2aaba023de6bebca50fc67356/research/one-query-endpoint-scan/source/q4-pauli-fusion/ONE-QUERY-ENDPOINT-OBSTRUCTION.md), [coverage and limits](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf793d8739ad26f2aaba023de6bebca50fc67356/research/one-query-endpoint-scan/README.md), and [task, scope change and open next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf793d8739ad26f2aaba023de6bebca50fc67356/research/one-query-endpoint-scan/TASK.json).

## Test plan

- [x] Fresh review at `bf793d8739ad26f2aaba023de6bebca50fc67356`: `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/one-query-endpoint-scan --check-source-history` and `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-query-endpoint-scan --check-only` pass. These establish committed bytes, history, metadata and pins.
- [x] [Existing hosted CI run 39248202294](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39248202294) is completed/success at that exact head, including registered normal/optimized replay. Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-query-endpoint-scan`. This review reused that run; it did not rerun the package suite.
- [x] Separate AI review inspected the tensor-ray, support, ADD and dirty-helper arguments and their actual native-source bindings; no actionable defect was found in that scope.

The earlier author-reported local and Git-free export checks are recorded in the [canonical finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3606#discussioncomment-19039338). AI review is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.
